turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have about twenty minutes, so let's not waste them. Why was my son's mark changed to a zero, and why did he find out from his phone?
I didn't ask how I feel, Hale. Who decided on the zero, and why did nobody call me before it went into the gradebook?
But I'm not changing the grade.
"Not changing the grade." On what basis, Hale? If it's the checker, I'll be in the principal's office when we're done.
I'm still not changing it. Keep going if you like.
I'm not here to keep going, Hale. Your own procedure says a parent is contacted before any mark is entered, and nobody called me. What do you have?
You can say it ten more ways. The answer is no.
"The answer is no." I'm writing that down, Hale, along with the fact that you haven't told me one reason. Give me a document or I'm going upstairs.
